page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, relying on network-attached storage and baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 10% to 25% categories. Single-threaded compression tasks, such as gzip and bzip3, also show poor throughput. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression all registering in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth reads and writes, along with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, also maintain average performance.

Given its dedicated hardware allocation and balanced resource profile, this instance offers a stable foundation for workloads that can leverage multi-threaded execution to overcome modest single-core speeds. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for standard enterprise applications, web serving, and database operations that do not require high-speed local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Appropriate workloads include multi-threaded software compilation, medium-scale web serving, and general-purpose business applications.
